title: Complex scalar field thick branes: stability of linear perturbation and evolution of scalar Kaluza-Klein modes coupled with gravity
summary: We investigate the stability and localization properties of Minkowski, de Sitter (dS), and anti-de Sitter (AdS) thick branes generated by a complex scalar field $Φ$. The scalar self-interaction potential contains a temperature parameter $a$. As $a$ approaches its critical value, the imaginary part of $Φ$ becomes double-kinked and the energy density splits into two peaks, indicating the formation of two sub-branes.
